question: A cylinder (r = 4 cm, h = 10 cm) is bored through by a hole (r = 2 cm, full height). What percentage of original volume is removed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the hole is bored through the entire height, the ratio of the volume removed depends only on the square of the radii.

Volume Removed % = (rₕₒₗₑ ÷ Rₒᵣᵢgᵢₙₐₗ)² × 100

⇒ Volume Removed % = (2 ÷ 4)² × 100

⇒ (1/2)² × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
